in_hebrew.name: גורל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word for 'light'. It is a feminine name, often given to girls. In the Bible, light is a symbol of God's presence and guidance.

in_greek.name: Γοργίλλα
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek words 'γοργός' (spear) and 'λλα' (maiden). In Greek mythology, Gorgilla was a beautiful spear-maiden, often depicted as a companion to the goddess Athena.

in_latin.name: Gurlia
in_latin.long_meaning: A name derived from the Latin words 'guris' (pledge) and 'alis' (powerful). In Roman culture, Gurlia was a name given to a girl who was a powerful pledge or guarantee of good fortune.
